description: This file defines data models for portfolio management requests and responses using Pydantic BaseModel. It contains schemas for portfolio allocation requests/responses and manual rebalancing requests/responses, which are likely used as input/output structures in a trading backend service.

classes.name: PortfolioAllocationRequest
classes.description: Model for requesting portfolio allocations, containing a list of allocation dictionaries.

classes.name: PortfolioAllocationResponse
classes.description: Model for responding to portfolio allocation requests, including status and message.

classes.name: ManualRebalanceRequest
classes.description: Model for requesting manual rebalancing, containing a list of actions.

classes.name: ManualRebalanceResponse
classes.description: Model for rebalancing response, including status and message.
